Lemma
[Structure of the parametrix error] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0254, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0255 1. ch23:23.19\group Convolution

For $N>n/2$, \[ \Box _xP_N=t^N(4\pi t)^{-n/2}e^{-d(x,y)^2/5t}q_N(x,y,t), \] where $q_N$ is smooth on $\mathcal M\times \mathcal M\times [0,\infty )$.
Proof

\sketch Use the product formula for $P_N$ and factor the Gaussian with denominator five. The terms containing derivatives of $\eta $ are supported where $d(x,y)\ge \operatorname {inj}(g)/4$, hence are flat at $t=0$; all other terms contain the factor $t^N$ by the defining equation for $H_N$.

□
